items.title: Custom webhooks + DeviceMonitor
items.body: Wire SolWhisper to anything that speaks HTTP. Mid-call mic switches no longer kill recordings — we catch the disconnect and let you keep going on AirPods.

items.title: Meeting pill + dictation history
items.body: Real per-bin waveform during meetings, clipping ring when you're hot, manual Summarize button, and a History tab so you can fish out anything you ever dictated. Stats appear on Home — start typing less.

items.title: Screen Capture (snip text)
items.body: Press a hotkey, drag a rectangle, paste anywhere. Vision OCR runs on-device, so even your most embarrassing screenshots stay between you and your hard drive.

items.title: Meeting recording lands
items.body: Mic + system audio captured side-by-side, transcribed, summarized with the skill of your choice (Generic / Sales / 1:1 / Standup / Brainstorm / Interview). Hermes + Obsidian fan-outs ship today; Slack is just a custom webhook away.

items.title: WhisperKit, fully offline
items.body: On-device transcription via Apple's Vision and Whisper models. Runs on a plane, in a tunnel, in your basement. No tokens billed.
